page.overview:
Who is Bernard Jaubert?

One of the pilots aboard the La Fayette (F710) frigate, Lieutenant Commander Bernard Jaubert was the captain of the new helicopter prototype the Tiger. He and his co-pilot Lt. François Brouse were to make the test flight, but Xenia Onatopp whistled to the pilots and told them she will be the surprise after the test. When they thought they are in heaven, Xenia shot them on their chest, took their flight suits and stole the helicopter before James Bond could stop them.
